name: Terraform + Observability
sub: IaC, Grafana, Kibana, NiFi, ML - 6 days
desc: Infrastructure-as-code and observability tools complete the production data engineering stack. Terraform makes infrastructure repeatable. Grafana/Kibana make pipelines visible. NiFi automates data movement.
tip: In Terraform interviews, the most impressive sentence is not I know the syntax but I store state remotely with S3+DynamoDB locking so two people can't apply simultaneously. That shows production thinking.

r: + = create, - = destroy, ~ = modify. Read plan before every apply.
S3 + DynamoDB for team use. Never commit .tfstate to Git.
Manual console changes that don't match Terraform state. Fix by re-applying or importing.
Time series for metrics over time. Stat for single current value.
Search raw log documents. KQL: level:ERROR AND service:pipeline.
Attributes (metadata) + Content (data bytes). The unit of data in NiFi.
Processor does work. Connection is a queue between processors.
Precision: of flagged positives, how many correct. Recall: of true positives, how many caught.

parts.title: Terraform -- IaC, plan/apply/destroy, variables, state
parts.summary: Terraform turns AWS resources into version-controlled code. .tf files describe what should exist, plan shows the diff, apply makes it real.

parts.title: Remote state, modules, capstone infrastructure
parts.summary: Remote state is the first thing a real team adds. Modules scale beyond one file -- together they make a team-shared system.

parts.title: Grafana -- dashboards, panels, alerting
parts.summary:
Grafana turns metrics into visibility. The JD's near-real-time dashboard is likely Grafana.

Understanding Grafana -- dashboards, panels, alerting at a senior e…

parts.title: Kibana + ELK -- log search, structured logging
parts.summary: Where Grafana shows metrics, Kibana shows logs. When your Spark job fails and you need the exact exception at 3am, you search Kibana Discover.

parts.title: Apache NiFi -- FlowFiles, processors, back-pressure
parts.summary: NiFi automates data movement -- the plumbing layer before Spark. Expect what is a FlowFile and how would you route based on content.

parts.title: ML literacy -- precision/recall, overfitting, MLOps
parts.summary: The JD mentions ML. You need to understand concepts well enough to discuss them in context, not build models from scratch.

parts.title: Enterprise Terraform Patterns & State Management
parts.summary: Senior DevOps/Platform interviews test Terraform state locking, workspace organization, import blocks, and OpenTofu migration.

parts.title: Production Observability Stack — OTel Collector, Prometheus & Loki
parts.summary: Architect full-stack observability pipelines using OpenTelemetry Collector, Prometheus Alertmanager, and Grafana Loki.
